name: ETS variant transcription factor 5
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ETV5 encodes ETS translocation variant 5. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
